div.p: Welcome to the Reading Lab! You will read two short texts:

ul.li: The Keeper and the Gull, a story about a lighthouse keeper and a seabird who needs his help, and
Why Bees Dance, a short information text about how honeybees share where the flowers are.

div.p: Each text comes with three questions. The text stays next to the questions on the same page, so you can read it again whenever you like.
Take your time and enjoy reading!

img.alt: A red and white lighthouse on the rocks at dusk, shining its beam across the sea while a seagull flies towards it.
